blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Incorrect exposure degrades both image brightness and recoverable scene detail. Existing sRGB-based correction methods are limited by the non-linear image signal processing pipeline, whereas RAW-based methods are usually developed for a single degradation type, such as low-light denoising or high-light recovery. In this paper, we focus on joint exposure correction and restoration directly in the RAW domain and propose a unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration (RIECR) framework for both under- and over-exposed images. RIECR decomposes the problem into two coupled sub-problems that follow the RAW imaging model: linear illumination correction and residual degradation restoration. First, a Linear Illumination Correction Network (LICN) estimates exposure-aware linear gains by using channel-specific RAW cues. It exploits the high signal-to-noise ratio of Green channels for robust brightening and the relatively unsaturated Red/Blue responses for high-light darkening. Second, a dual-branch Frequency-based Enhancement Network (FEN) restores the remaining degradation with a Frequency Dynamic Convolution (FDC) module. FDC decomposes convolutional responses into low- and high-frequency components and adaptively suppresses amplified noise or recovers clipped textures according to the exposure context. We further build a real paired RAW benchmark containing 223 scenes and 1,784 pairs covering complex multi-exposure errors. Experiments against sixteen state-of-the-art methods show that RIECR achieves state-of-the-art performance on real RAW exposure correction.
blocks.zh: 不正确的曝光会同时降低图像亮度和可回收的场景细节. 现有的基于sRGB的校正方法受到非线性图像信号处理管道的限制,而基于RAW的方法通常为单一的降解型开发,如低光去诺或高光回收. 在本文中,我们侧重于在RAW领域直接进行联合曝光校正和修复,并为未曝光和过度曝光的图像提出统一的RAW图像校正和修复框架。 RIECR将问题分解成遵循RAW成像模型的两个连结子问题:线性照明校正和剩余降解还原. 首先,一个线性照明校正网络(LICN)通过使用频道专用RAW提示来估计接触感线性增益. 它利用Green通道的高信号对噪声比来进行强亮,相对不饱和的Red/Blue反应来进行高光变暗. 其次,一个基于频率的双分支增强网络(FEN)用频率动态转录(FDC)模块恢复剩余的降解. blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Exposure correction improves visibility and preserves scene detail for both photography and downstream tasks such as segmentation and detection [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Yet exposure errors are not a single degradation [ 6 ] . Limited photons in under-exposed scenes produce photon shot noise, sensor noise [ 7 ] , and color distortion [ 8 ] ; limited sensor range in over-exposed scenes saturates and irreversibly clips bright structures [ 9 ] . A practical model must therefore restore exposure-dependent content as well as brightness.
blocks.zh: 曝光校正提高了能见度,并保留了摄影和下游任务(如分区和检测)的场景细节[1,2,3,4,5]. 然而,接触错误并不是一种单一的降解[6]。 曝光不足场景中的有限光子产生光子射噪声,传感器噪声[7],以及颜色扭曲[8];过度曝光场景中的传感器范围有限饱和,并不可逆转地剪断亮度结构[9]. 因此,实用模型必须恢复依赖接触的内容和亮度。

blocks.en: Learning-based sRGB correction has progressed rapidly [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] . However, sRGB is produced by a nonlinear ISP involving demosaicking, white balance, tone mapping, and quantization [ 18 ] ; amplified noise or clipped highlights are then difficult to recover. RAW data, as shown in Fig. 1 , retains higher bit depth and a near-linear radiance response [ 9 , 19 , 20 ] , making it a better domain for physical exposure correction. Nevertheless, RAW methods remain task-specific, separating low-light denoising [ 18 , 21 ] from high-light recovery [ 9 ] . A unified model must estimate a valid linear gain and restore the direction-dependent residual within one network.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的SRGB校正进展迅速[10,11,12,13,14,15,16,17]. 然而,sRGB是由一个非线性ISP生成的,涉及demosaick,白平衡,音调映射,以及量化[18];放大噪声或剪断的亮点随后很难恢复. 如图1所示,RAW数据保留了较高的位深度和近线性光度响应[9,19,20],使其成为物理曝光校正的更好领域. 尽管如此,RAW方法仍然是针对特定任务的,将低光去声[18,21]与高光回收[9]区分开来. 一个统一的模型必须估计一个有效的线性收益,并恢复一个网络内依赖方向的剩余部分。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration (RIECR) , which explicitly decomposes the task into two coupled sub-problems. First , the Linear Illumination Correction Network (LICN) predicts the exposure direction and estimates linear gains from complementary RAW channels: Green offers robust high-SNR cues for low-light brightening, while Red/Blue often remain less saturated and guide high-light darkening. Second , the Frequency-based Enhancement Network (FEN) restores the remaining degradation through local convolution and global attention. Its Frequency Dynamic Convolution (FDC) decomposes kernel responses and adaptively suppresses amplified high-frequency noise or emphasizes missing texture according to the exposure context.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议RAW图像曝光校正和修复(RIECR),明确将任务分解为两个连结的子问题. 首先,线性照明校正网络(LICN)预测接触方向,并估算来自互补的RAW通道的线性收益: Green为低光亮提供强大的高SNR提示,而Red/Blue则经常保持较不饱和,并引导高光亮变暗. 第二,基于频率的增强网络(FEN)通过局部演化和全球关注来恢复剩余的退化. 其频率动态转录(FDC)分解内核响应,并适应性地抑制放大高频噪声,或根据接触环境强调缺失的纹理.

blocks.en:
Because existing RAW datasets usually cover only one exposure subtask [ 18 , 9 , 22 ] , we collect Complex Multi-Exposure RAW (CMER), with 223 real scenes and 1,784 pairs spanning both directions, and synthesize additional pre-training pairs from MIT-Adobe FiveK [ 23 ] . CMER supplies pixel-aligned supervision for unified evaluation, while the synthetic data tests whether broader exposure coverage benefits real-data fine-tuning. Extensive experiments show consistent improvements under both training protocols and exposure directions.
In summary, the main contributions are summarized as follows: • We establish a unified RAW-domain formulation for simultaneous exposure correction and restoration. By addressing divergent degradations, our framework provides a holistic solution to the RAW-domain multi-exposure errors within a single model. • We propose two physically motivated components: a linear illumination correction network for exposure-aware linear gain estimation from channel-specific RAW cues, and a frequency-based enhancement network with dynamic convolution for adaptive restoration of divergent frequency degradations. • We construct CMER, a paired real RAW benchmark with 223 scenes and 1,784 multi-exposure pairs for unified RAW-based exposure correction and restoration tasks under diverse lighting conditions.

由于现有的RAW数据集通常只覆盖一个曝光子任务[18,9,22],我们收集了复杂的多曝光RAW(CMER),有223个真实场景和1,784对横跨双向的对,并合成了来自MIT-Adobe FiveK [23]的额外训练前对. CMER为统一评价提供像素匹配的监管,而合成数据则测试更广泛的接触范围是否有利于实数据微调。 广泛的实验表明,在训练规程和接触方向方面都不断改进。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Single Image High Dynamic Range Reconstruction: SIHDR expands local dynamic range through inverse tone mapping [ 24 ] , direct CNN/Transform reconstruction [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] , exposure-stack synthesis [ 28 ] , or inverse-camera modeling [ 29 , 30 ] . RawHDR further exploits high-bit-depth RAW measurements [ 31 ] . These methods recover localized dynamic-range loss from a nominally exposed input and usually assume a usable global tone, whereas exposure correction must infer the global rescaling.
blocks.zh: 单一图像高动态 区域重建 : SIHDR通过反声调映射[24],直接CNN/变形重建[25,26,27],曝光-sack合成[28],或反相机模型[29,30]来扩展本地动态范围. Raw HDR进一步利用高比特深度RAW测量[31]. 这些方法从名义上暴露的输入物中恢复局部动态距损失,通常采用可用的全球语气,而暴露矫正则必须推断全球的伸缩。

blocks.en: Low-Light Image Enhancement: Classical enhancement adjusts histograms, suppresses noise, or decomposes illumination and reflectance [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] . Learning-based methods employ illumination decomposition, color spaces, frequency embedding, transformers, and Mamba architectures [ 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] . RAW restoration additionally models sensor noise for synthesis and removal [ 44 , 45 , 7 , 21 , 46 ] . These methods are effective for photon-limited inputs but typically assume a known exposure ratio and do not address clipping-dominated over-exposure.
blocks.zh: 低亮图像增强:古典增强调整直方图,抑制噪音,或分解照明和反射[32,33,34]. 基于学习的方法采用照明分解,色彩空间,频率嵌入,变压器,以及曼巴建筑[35,36,37,38,39,40,41,42,43]. RAW还原额外的模型传感器噪声用于合成和清除[44,45,7,21,46]. 这些方法对光子有限输入有效,但通常假定已知的接触比率,不处理剪切为主的过度接触。

blocks.en:
Image Exposure Correction: Classical exposure correction uses histogram, tone, or Retinex adjustment [ 32 , 47 , 48 ] , while high-light-specific networks recover brightness and clipped content [ 49 , 50 , 9 ] .
Deep learning has seen rapid development recently [ 51 , 52 , 53 , 54 ] , unified sRGB methods learn coarse-to-fine correction, exposure consistency, luminance, color-space, or task-shared mappings [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 55 ] . Guided reconstruction can exploit frequency cues or cross-modal structure [ 56 , 57 , 58 , 59 , 60 , 61 , 62 ] , but does not connect them to RAW exposure formation. Existing RAW methods still separate low-light restoration [ 19 , 21 , 18 ] and high-light recovery [ 9 ] ; RIECR instead couples RAW-linear gain estimation with exposure-adaptive residual restoration.

Complex Multiple Exposure RAW (CMER) Dataset: We capture 223 static indoor/outdoor scenes with a Canon EOS 5D Mark IV and save 14-bit RAW images. The scenes include dark smooth regions, strong light sources, reflective materials, and fine structures. A tripod and remote control fix the viewpoint; after acquiring a well-exposed reference, we fix aperture and vary only exposure time. Captures with motion, illumination variation, or misalignment are discarded, preserving pixel alignment.
Daytime images use ISO 100; nighttime inputs additionally use ISO 1,600–6,400 while references remain at ISO 100. We record over-exposure ratios {2,4,8} and under-exposure ratios { 1 / 2 1/2 , 1 / 4 1/4 , 1 / 8 1/8 , 1 / 16 1/16 , 1 / 32 1/32 } [ 70 ] . CMER contains 1,784 pairs at 6720 × 4480 6720\times 4480 : 669 over-exposed and 1,115 under-exposed. A scene-disjoint split uses 213 scenes (1,704 pairs) for training and 10 scenes (80 pairs) for testing.
Data samples and comparative data analysis are shown in Fig. 4 .

Evaluation between RAW and sRGB. We train RIECR on CMER RAW data and sRGB counterparts generated by the same ISP [ 21 ] , and evaluate both through that ISP. Table V shows that RAW improves average PSNR/SSIM from 28.35 dB/0.905 to 29.62 dB/0.919. The gain occurs in both subsets because linear high-bit-depth RAW preserves highlights before tone mapping and enables physically consistent low-light scaling and noise restoration.
As shown in Fig. 9 , the visual example further shows that RAW input preserves recoverable high-light details that are already compressed or clipped in sRGB. This confirms that the rich detail, higher bit depth, and linear response of RAW data are crucial for joint exposure correction and restoration.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed RIECR, a unified RAW-domain framework that bridges the information loss of sRGB correction and the single-degradation focus of task-specific RAW restoration. Following the physical RAW formation model, RIECR decomposes joint under- and over-exposure restoration into linear illumination correction and residual enhancement. LICN estimates exposure-aware gains through channel-specific guidance, using the high SNR of Green channels for under-exposure and the less saturated Red/Blue responses for over-exposure. FEN then addresses the divergent residual degradations, while FDC separates low- and high-frequency responses to adaptively suppress amplified noise and recover weakened high-light structures. We further constructed CMER with 223 real scenes and 1,784 paired RAW images and built a synthetic dataset for pre-training. Comparisons with sixteen methods, component ablations, RAW/sRGB evaluation, efficiency analysis, and cross-camera tests validate the unified formulation and its components. RIECR achieves 33.85 dB/0.951 after pre-training and fine-tuning with 2.56 M parameters. Future work will extend CMER to dynamic scenes and broader sensors and explore metadata-aware correction and stronger priors for severely clipped regions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了RIECR,一个统一的RAW域框架,用以弥补SRGB校正的信息损失和任务特定RAW修复的单降解重点. 遵循物理RAW形成模型,RIECR将联合的接触下和过度接触还原分解为线性照明校正和剩余增强. LICN通过针对通道的引导,利用绿色通道的高SNR进行接触不足和饱和度较低的红色/蓝色反应进行接触超暴露度的估算,从而估计接触感的增益. FEN随后解决了不同的残留降解,而FDC则分离出低频和高频响应,以适应性地抑制放大噪声,恢复弱化的高光结构. 我们用223个真实场景和1 784个对齐的RAW图像进一步建造了CMER,并建立了一个用于预训的合成数据集. 与16种方法的比较、组件缩放、RAW/sRGB评价、效率分析和跨镜头测试验证了统一配方及其组件。 RIECR在经过预训和微调后,以2.56M参数实现33.85 dB/0.951. 今后的工作将扩大CMER的范围,使之包括动态场景和更广泛的传感器,并探索对严重剪辑区域进行元数据感知校正和更强的前科。
